title: ToxicTone: A Mandarin Audio Dataset Annotated for Toxicity and Toxic Utterance Tonality
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and benchmarking of a dataset for toxic speech detection in Mandarin audio. While it categorizes forms of toxicity like hate speech and profanity, which relate to social safety, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
